attribution.note: The words are Marcus's own, from his signed Substack post, in his own voice and not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: Calling the prospect 'bonkers' carries no hedge. It firmly commits him to such chatbots not existing within a year. The horizon (about Feb 2025) and the threshold (perfectly reliable, hallucination-free) are preserved.

contract.note: Reading 'perfectly reliable, hallucination-free' as no measurable hallucination follows his literal words. Reading 'bonkers' as a firm expectation is a natural reading. A measured nonzero rate for leading models meets the support condition under any reasonable reading.

evidence.note: Independent leaderboard updated 28 Feb 2025, about five days after the horizon, which fits 'around February 2025'. The best model, Gemini 2.0 Flash (available by then), scored 0.7%, and every listed model was above zero. It covers summarization only, which limits scope but still shows measurable hallucination.

output.rationale: The horizon (23 Feb 2025) has passed. Vectara's leaderboard of 28 Feb 2025 shows every leading model hallucinating at a measurable rate, the lowest being 0.7%. The packet contains no evidence of any hallucination-free chatbot. This meets the support condition. Caveat: the benchmark covers summarization only.
